$schema-comment: Claude Code plugin hook manifest. The Stop event fires once per assistant response, every turn end. The hook calls `bettermemory hook stop`, a standard-library client that posts the hook's stdin JSON (session_id and transcript_path) to the local daemon, which runs the silent-miss probe over the pool memory_search would have built for that message (`hook.audit_transcript`), settles the turn's retrievals as applied and the recall's shown pointers when the reply used them, and records `turn_audited` / `search_miss` events. The client starts the daemon when none answers and always exits 0; the trailing `|| true` keeps a uvx network failure or an older wheel without the subcommand from surfacing as a hook error banner. Losing one turn of telemetry is preferable to interrupting the user.
$schema-comment-session-start: The SessionStart event fires when a conversation opens; its stdout is injected verbatim into the model's context. `bettermemory hook session-start` asks the daemon for the session brief: up to eight pointers (id and summary, never a body) to the newest memories written in the current repository whose staleness verdict is fresh, under a header that says they are pointers, not instructions. A shown brief is recorded as a `session_brief` event; it prints nothing outside a repository or when nothing is fresh, and always exits 0. A clear opens a new recall segment, and so does a compact whose compaction marker the transcript holds. MATCHER DELIBERATELY OMITTED: an omitted matcher means match all, and every SessionStart matcher (startup, resume, clear, compact, fork) wants the brief; clear and compact have just discarded the context it supplies. Timeout 20 s because this one blocks session open and may be the call that starts the daemon.
$schema-comment-prompt-recall: The UserPromptSubmit event fires when the user submits a prompt, before the model sees it; stdout on exit 0 is injected into the model's context. `bettermemory hook prompt` asks the daemon to probe the prompt through production's search pool and ranker; up to three relevant memories written in this project, not shown, retrieved, written or updated in the session segment, come back as pointers (id, relevance, summary and snippet, never a body) and are recorded as a `prompt_recall` event, which the Stop hook's audit of the same turn reads as a delivery. `[behavior] prompt_recall` takes project, everywhere or off, and with telemetry off it refuses to inject rather than inject off the books. MATCHER DELIBERATELY OMITTED. Timeout 10 s, the tightest of the three, because it sits between the user pressing enter and the model starting.
